description: Positive-inside topology check, UIM comparison with LAPTM5, and enrichment figure for the C-terminal PPxY+YxxPhi module
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
human="MRRQPAKVAALLLGLLLECTEAKKHCWYFEGLYPTYYICRSYEDCCGSRCCVRALSIQRLWYFWFLLMMGVLFCCGAGFFIRRRMYPPPLIEEPAFNVSYTRQPPNPGPGAQQPGPPYYTDPGGPGMNPVGNSMAMAFQVPPNSPQGSVACPPPPAYCNTPPPPYEQVVKAK"

# ---- positive-inside rule check for the TM 61-81, isoform 1 vs signal-peptide-less isoforms ----
def netcharge(s): return sum(1 for a in s if a in "KR") - sum(1 for a in s if a in "DE")
print("=== positive-inside analysis around TM 61-81 ===")
for nm,s in [("isoform 1 (mature, after SP cleavage at 22)",human[22:]),
             ("isoform 1 (precursor)",human)]:
    i=s.find("WYFWFLLMMGVLFCCGAGFFI")
    flankN=s[max(0,i-30):i]; flankC=s[i+21:i+51]
    print(f"  {nm}\n     N-flank(30) {flankN}  net {netcharge(flankN):+d}\n     C-flank(30) {flankC}  net {netcharge(flankC):+d}")
for iso in ["Q96AW1-2","Q96AW1-3","Q96AW1-4"]:
    s="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{iso}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
    i=s.find("WYFWFLLMMGVLFCCGAGFFI")
    flankN=s[max(0,i-30):i]; flankC=s[i+21:i+51]
    print(f"  {iso}: N-flank net {netcharge(flankN):+d} (whole N-region 1-{i}: net {netcharge(s[:i]):+d}), C-flank net {netcharge(flankC):+d}")

# ---- UIM check (LAPTM5 has one, does VOPP1?) ----
uim=r'[DE][DE][DE].{0,2}[LIM]...A...S...[DE]'
print("\nUIM-like match in VOPP1 tail:", re.findall(uim,human) or "none")
print("acidic residues in cytoplasmic tail 82-172: D=%d E=%d of %d residues"%(
    human[81:].count('D'),human[81:].count('E'),len(human[81:])))
laptm5="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q13571.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
print("LAPTM5 PY motifs:", [(m.start()+1,laptm5[m.start():m.start()+4]) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=[LP]P.Y)',laptm5)])
print("LAPTM5 UIM-like match:", re.findall(uim,laptm5) or "none")

# ---- summary comparison table (artifact) ----
comp=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(protein="VOPP1 (Q96AW1)",length=172,topology="type I, 1 TM",n_PPxY=3,n_conserved_PPxY=2,
      Cterm_module="PPPPYEQV (PPxY+YxxPhi)",cyto_Lys=2,UIM="no",
      compartment="late endosome / lysosome membrane",NEDD4_evidence="AP-MS co-IP (PMID 33961781)"),
 dict(protein="LAPTM5 (Q13571)",length=262,topology="multi-pass",n_PPxY=len(re.findall(r'(?=[LP]P.Y)',laptm5)),
      n_conserved_PPxY=3,Cterm_module="PAPPPYSEV (PPxY+YxxPhi)",cyto_Lys=np.nan,UIM="yes",
      compartment="lysosome membrane",NEDD4_evidence="direct binding, PY-dependent (PMID 17116753)"),
 dict(protein="TMEM207 (Q6UWW9)",length=146,topology="type I, 1 TM",n_PPxY=len(re.findall(r'(?=PP.Y)',
      "".join(requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q6UWW9.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]))),
      n_conserved_PPxY=np.nan,Cterm_module="SPPPYEEIVKTT (PPxY+YxxPhi)",cyto_Lys=np.nan,UIM="?",
      compartment="early endosome membrane",NEDD4_evidence="not tested here"),
])
pd.set_option('display.width',300); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',40)
print("\n=== architecture comparison ===")
print(comp.to_string(index=False))
comp.to_csv("table6_VOPP1_vs_PY_motif_endolysosomal_proteins.tsv",sep="\t",index=False)

# ---- figure: enrichment of the C-terminal module set ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
cats=["PPxY anywhere","PPxY + YxxPhi\noverlapping (anywhere)","overlapping module\nin C-terminal 25 aa"]
vals=[100*1303/20414,100*403/20414,100*33/20414]
ax[0].bar(cats,vals,color=["#a0aec0","#90cdf4","#2b6cb0"])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax[0].text(i,v+0.12,f"{v:.2f}%\n(n={[1303,403,33][i]})",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% of 20,414 reviewed human proteins"); ax[0].set_ylim(0,7.6)
ax[0].set_title("VOPP1's C-terminal module is rare in the human proteome")
grp=["C-terminal module set\n(n=33, includes VOPP1)","all reviewed human proteins\n(n=20,414)"]
ax[1].bar(grp,[100*11/33,100*1556/20414],color=["#2f855a","#cbd5e0"])
ax[1].text(0,100*11/33+1.2,"33 %",ha="center",fontsize=9); ax[1].text(1,100*1556/20414+1.2,"7.6 %",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_ylabel("% annotated endosome / lysosome / vesicle")
ax[1].set_title("Fisher exact OR = 6.1, p = 2.0e-05")
ax[1].set_ylim(0,45)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
